answers.how: The truck spans about 674 px. Its fitted image acceleration is about 817 px/s², giving a scale of 817/10.757 ≈ 75.95 px/m.
The truck is about 258 px tall, from the upper railing to the tire bottoms. Using the acceleration-derived scale of approximately 75.95 px/m gives 3.40 m.
The tire diameter is about 64 px. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of approximately 75.95 px/m gives 0.84 m.
Fitting the truck's positions over time indicates an approximately zero initial speed. Thus v(1) = 10.757 × 1.
The position fit indicates an approximately zero initial speed. Thus v(1.5) = 10.757 × 1.5.
